rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for perfect happiness, especially in phrases such as 「享受呢份幸福」.

example.english: Having tea every day after retirement is truly bliss.
example.traditional: 退休後每日飲茶，真係享受呢份幸福。
example.jyutping: teoi3 jau1 hau6 mui5 jat6 jam2 caa4 zan1 hai6 hoeng2 sau6 ne1 fan2 hang6 fuk1

rows.note: Use this when you mean the felt sense or emotional experience of bliss rather than bliss as an abstract state.

example.english: After volunteering, I felt a strong sense of bliss.
example.traditional: 做完義工之後，我有一種好強嘅幸福感。
example.jyutping: zou6 jyun4 ji6 gung1 zi1 hau6 ngo5 jau5 jat1 zung2 hou3 koeng4 ge3 hang6 fuk1 gam2
